bare.comment: Dial starts at 2; reaching 4 makes the room cold, reaching 3 makes it warm, and if it never reaches 3 the room is warm only after the last action was "turn up".

random answers.comment: Simulate the inferred hidden 5-state machine: wait does nothing; states 1 and 4 are warm, others cold.

rivals choose.comment: Ignore waits; if first two non-waits are both turn up, cold; else warm if last non-wait is turn up or last three are up,up,down; else cold.

rivals.comment: Explanation: hidden dial position d and heat level t; each action adds zone-dependent heat, warm iff t > 0.
Explanation: hidden reset latch keyed by whether a down-up pair appears before the first up gets followed by a down.
Explanation: hidden counters of ups and downs plus last-action register; warm only when these form specific patterns.
Explanation: hidden length-sensitive mode; warm only for short sequences matching a down-up pattern or a length-four down-start pattern.
Hidden first-action latch: warm if the first action was turn down (unless the exact cold pattern D U D D) or the second action was turn down.
Hidden up/down counters plus first/second action: warm if more downs than ups, or first was down, or second was down; two exact histories are cold exceptions.

Hidden last-action sensor with counters: if last was up, warm when ups <= 2 and downs >= 1; if last was down, warm only if first was down (unless D U D D); if last was wait, warm only if first was down.
Hidden third-action sensor: if third was up, warm when first or second was down; if third was down, warm only if first was down (unless D U D D); if third was wait, warm when second was down.
